zh.title: 说明
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.4** 是任务流 Agent 的正式版，汇总自 0.0.3 以来的 Goal 落地、工作台协作与通道扩展。
后续 Goal 收成一条 Goal Thread，工作台只保留一张卡片。
绑定仓库的 Goal 可在隔离 worktree 落地，验收后再合回，并补上交付路由与质检闭环。
设置可直接添加 OpenRouter；Grok 支持 Fast / xhigh。
工作台讨论、已读、搜索和刷新更稳，侧边栏改为项目文件夹入口。

zh.title: 新功能
items: **Goal Thread**：后续验收卡并入同一条线程；模型漏传 `parentPlanId` 时，也会挂到最近完成的计划上。工作台按线程只显示一张卡，外壳绑到最新待处理轮次，并内嵌精简的父子树。
**Goal 隔离落地**：绑定仓库的 Goal 在独立 Git worktree 中执行；验收后可把隔离改动合回原工作区，并显示交付交接状态。
**交付路由与质检**：按交付类型走不同落地路径，并在查看结果后再进入质检循环。
**OpenRouter**：设置可添加官方 OpenRouter API，预填 Base URL 与 API Key，作为第三方 OpenAI Chat 通道。
**Grok Fast / xhigh**：Grok 支持 Fast 模式，以及更高的 xhigh 推理强度。
**项目文件夹**：侧边栏改为打开项目文件夹，不再用关闭工作区替代本地目录入口。
**工作台可见性**：运行中任务有侧边栏标记；项目讨论可显示未读；会话搜索按工作区分组；结果抽屉增加滚动按钮。

zh.title: 优化
items: **多任务性能**：任务总览按当前会话或工作区索引查询，合并滚动探测，暂停被抽屉覆盖页面的后台刷新。
**工作台讨论与队列**：首页讨论区即使没有未读也会保留，待处理结果全部展示，不再只预览四张卡。
**刷新节流**：合并 `taskOverview:changed` 广播，隐藏窗口时跳过重载，托盘重建降频，未变计划索引走缓存。
**已读与布局**：任务总览持久保存已读状态，统一运行中 / 中断卡片层级，减少刷新闪烁。
**任务续接**：继续既有任务与提交新输入分开处理；恢复会话时保留推理强度。
**产品叙事**：README 与文档站统一到「完全开源 + 任务流」表述。

zh.title: 修复
items: 修复多任务并行时打开抽屉、滚动或输入卡顿。
修复中断 Goal 状态丢失，以及未打开任务的高频进度事件拖慢当前页面。
修复隔离 worktree 消失、验收后清理、前台 runner 对账和未验收计划被覆盖。
统一 SkillHub 工具栏控件圆角，品牌图标回退到开天空猫原画。

zh.title: CLI（仅命令行）
items: 本版 GitHub Release 附带 CLI 归档（与 Desktop 同 tag / 同版本）。
可通过 `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`（或 `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`）安装正式版；`postinstall` 会拉取本版归档。
也可手动解压归档，将目录加入 `PATH`，执行 `peer --version` 校验后运行 `peer`。
CLI 与 Desktop 继续共享 `~/.peer-agent` 下的会话和设置。

en.title: Overview
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.4** is the stable Task Flow release that gathers Goal landing, workbench collaboration, and channel expansion since 0.0.3.
Follow-up Goals collapse into one Goal Thread, so the workbench keeps a single card.
Bound Goals can land in an isolated worktree, merge back after acceptance, and run delivery routing plus a quality-review loop.
Settings can add OpenRouter directly; Grok supports Fast and xhigh.
Workbench discussions, read state, search, and refresh are steadier, and the sidebar opens project folders.

en.title: What's New
items: **Goal Thread**: related acceptance cards share one thread; later follow-ups attach to the last completed plan when the model omits `parentPlanId`. The result grid shows one card per thread, bound to the latest pending round, with a compact parent/child tree.
**Isolated Goal landing**: bound Goals run in a dedicated Git worktree; accepted changes can merge back into the origin workspace, with a visible delivery handoff.
**Delivery routing and quality review**: different landing paths by delivery type, and a quality-review loop that starts after the result is viewed.
**OpenRouter**: add the official OpenRouter API from settings, with a prefilled base URL and API key, as a third-party OpenAI Chat channel.
**Grok Fast / xhigh**: Grok supports Fast mode and a higher xhigh reasoning effort.
**Project folders**: the sidebar opens a project folder instead of closing the workspace.
**Workbench visibility**: running tasks are marked in the sidebar; project discussions can show unread state; conversation search groups by workspace; the result drawer has a scroll button.

en.title: Improvements
items: **Parallel-task performance**: task overview queries the current session or workspace index, merges scroll probes, and pauses background refresh under drawers.
**Discussions and queues**: the home discussion section stays even when nothing is unread, and the full result-ready queue is shown instead of a four-card preview.
**Refresh throttle**: merge `taskOverview:changed` broadcasts, skip hidden reloads, back off tray rebuilds, and cache unchanged plan indexes.
**Read state and layout**: persist task-overview read state, unify running / interrupted card hierarchy, and reduce refresh flicker.
**Task continuation**: keep continuing an existing task separate from submitting new input, and preserve reasoning effort when restoring a session.
**Product narrative**: README and the docs site now lead with fully open source plus task flow.

en.title: Fixes
items: Fix drawer, scroll, and input jank when multiple tasks run in parallel.
Preserve interrupted Goal state, and stop unread task progress events from slowing the current page.
Treat vanished worktrees as already cleaned, collect worktree changes before cleanup, reconcile the foreground runner, and keep unaccepted plans across follow-ups.
Unify SkillHub toolbar control radius, and restore the open-sky cat brand icons.

en.title: CLI (command-line only)
items: This GitHub Release ships CLI archives under the same tag and version as Desktop.
Install the stable channel with `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@latest` (or `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`); `postinstall` downloads this release's archive.
Alternatively, unpack an archive manually, add its directory to `PATH`, run `peer --version`, and then run `peer`.
CLI and Desktop continue to share sessions and settings under `~/.peer-agent`.
